title: v1.4.0 — Minute-Level Goal Progress & Incremental Daily Tracking
changelog: Minute-Level Goal Updates: Log daily progress in granular increments without waiting for full routine blocks
Natural Unit Tracking: Native calibrated metrics for cycling (km), reading (chapters), courses (topics), and habits (minutes)
Quick-Add Action Presets: 1-tap increments calibrated to minimum tracker resolution (e.g. +1 km, +5 km, +10 km, +15 km; +1 ch, +5 ch; +1 topic, +2 topics; +1m, +5m, +15m)
Collapsible Daily Goals Bar: Rapid progress tracking directly from Today Timeline schedule without leaving the view
Precision Progress Bar: Capped at 100% with true accumulated duration and 1 decimal place percentage accuracy
Double-Counting Protection: Deterministic engine prevents duplicates between manual increments and routine occurrence logs
1-Click Undo & Entry History: Immediate mistake recovery and daily audit log per goal
Cloud Sync & Backup Integration: Full offline local storage, Firestore real-time listeners, and routine backup archive support
